scope: Ayodhya Kanda Sargas 66–95, 90 linked verse-adjudication records

source_policy_evidence.finding: Publisher describes restrictions on copying volunteer-prepared content for promotion of a separate website and directs requesters to contact the publisher for intended use; personal study and research are distinguished from copying/reposting.
Site states volunteer-prepared files are intended for personal study/research and must not be copied or reposted for website promotion or commercial use without permission.

A separate Ramayana e-text index describes a Devanagari encoding originating from a published critical-edition encoding and separately links a Southern Recension and translations; this does not establish that RamaVerse's cited sarga witnesses use the same edition or may be redistributed.

risk_assessment.finding: No documented licence or explicit permission for RamaVerse to redistribute the cited digitised source transcription or third-party translated text.
risk_assessment.scope_limit: Publisher policy is not a determination of copyright subsistence in underlying ancient verses, and particular archived/mirrored pages may have additional terms. Verify individual provenance and permissions before copying any text.
risk_assessment.editorial_reference_and_linking: Evidence citations and independently written short review notes may be retained only subject to applicable legal/contractual assessment; do not treat a link as a reuse licence.

mandatory_release_conditions: Identify the actual edition/recension and source chain for each online witness; avoid equating the separate Baroda critical edition and Southern Recension.
Obtain explicit documented permission for any proposed reuse of Sanskrit Documents' prepared files or use a separately verified licensed/public-domain edition after provenance review.
Independently author and approve English and Tamil translations; do not reproduce third-party translations without rights.
Bind source identifiers, verse numbering, licences, publisher permissions and reviewer sign-offs in the versioned registry under its controlled workflow.
Keep all 90 noncanonical records on HOLD; do not publish, promote, merge or deploy as a result of this report.
limitations: Web policy observed 2026-11-12; no direct publisher correspondence or contract was reviewed.
Further source-specific licensing and legal interpretation may alter the risk assessment.
No source text, translation, digital edition or images are copied into this report.

witness_inventory.method: Read-only extraction of witness_url and publication_decision from all 90 review queue entries; hostnames treated literally (www and bare domain retained separately)
witness_inventory.publisher_scope: Every entry links to the Sanskrit Documents domain (including www alias); this is one website-level source-policy review cluster, not proof of one identical edition, license or file producer.
witness_inventory.limitations: HTTP links are cited editorial witnesses only; no bulk reuse authorization, edition binding or original text comparison is established by this host inventory.
